title: The Matrix Awakens
host: Linux, Proton Experimental, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti SUPER
setup: Private copies of the reference game layout and prefix, with the TuxBox D3D12 DLL swapped into each native-provider trial. The launcher selected Frosty from its compiled game configuration and ran normal shader preparation.
research_cache: For fullcache and later diagnostic trials, exact cooked source hashes from the working reference were preloaded in each private prefix; linked shaders were selected by producer and consumer hash. The verified desktop configuration is recorded separately.

screen.observed: Start Chase selected, Settings visible, movie preview present

trials.observation: Reference provider, observed Start Chase and Settings at 50 seconds.

trials.observation: Reached the 4K studio intro, then Start Chase and Settings with a moving preview. The private trial was stopped at the menu for the physical desktop launch.

result: TuxBox rendered the retail main menu on the Linux desktop. The logo, both rows, the settings panel and changing video preview were visible.

desktop.configuration: Separate Linux working copy and prefix. Normal launcher, extended menu profile, desktop audio enabled, Xbox startup-movie plugin disabled. The existing Game Runtime, storage, input and media bridges were retained.
desktop.driver_cache: Copied the completed private run’s vkd3d output cache into this installation before launch.
desktop.log_capture: Snapshots taken while the retail game was still running at its menu.

inputs.keyboard: With Frosty focused, K opened the Settings panel and I returned to Start Chase.
inputs.xinput: A Linux virtual Xbox 360 controller exposed through Proton XInput selected Settings with D-pad down and returned to Start Chase with D-pad up.

desktop.remaining: The green digital rain behind the menu is missing. This TuxBox-renderer run stopped testing at the menu; interactive chase gameplay remains unverified.
